# 雜譬喻經

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle *pìyù*-anthology of 32 narratives, anonymous translation appended to the Hàn register. Signature: 「失譯人名附後漢錄」. The opening parable: "A bodhisattva delivering beings is like a skilled wet-nurse caring for an infant: there are four duties — first, to bathe him clean; second, to feed him so he is full; third, to lay him to sleep peacefully; fourth, to protect him from harm…"

**Abstract**

T205 is one of three Taishō *Zá pìyù jīng* anthologies (T204, T205, T207); see [T204](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0061) for the full series-discussion. The Hàn-register attribution in the catalog is conventional rather than documented; modern scholarship (Mizuno) treats this anthology as one of several anonymous Hàn-period Chinese-language *pìyù* compilations whose actual translation date and provenance remain uncertain.
